Hello,

### Thank you for your inquiry.

In response to your question about how to calculate the family size when it has changed in the past few years.

The family size is calculated on the day on which the application is filed and the sponsor must advise IRCC (via the webform) of any change in the family composition. The size of the family determines the amount of income required to meet the sponsorship eligibility requirements.

The regulations require that the sponsor provides proof of income from the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) for the 3 consecutive taxation years immediately preceding the date of the sponsorship application to prove Minimum Necessary Income (MNI) can be met.

If the family size changes during the processing of the sponsorship application, the income requirements for each applicable year will also change.

fthe sponsor has received the Notice of Assessment (NOA) for 2018, the sponsor must provide NOA's from 2018, 2017 and 2016, and the income requirements would need to be met for a family size of three.

f the sponsor has not received the tax Notice of Assessment (NOA) for 2018, the sponsor must provide NOA's from 2017, 2016 and 2015. In 2017 and 2016, income requirements would need to be met for a family size of three and in 2015, income requirements would need to be met for a family size of two.

I hope the above answers your questions.
